ideas.pitch: An automated market validation and TAM/SAM/SOM calculator designed specifically for the Shark Tank-style final pitch at Startup Street 11, ingesting pitch transcripts to generate investor-ready competitive matrices.
ideas.title: StartupStreet Validator AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core focus of Startup Street 11, which emphasizes ideation and market validation for the final judges.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered compliance and risk detector for early-stage business models, scanning financial projections and unit economics for fatal flaws before the elimination rounds.
ideas.title: PitchDeck Risk Radar
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the exact AML and risk detection methodology that won the DIGITIMES AI Innovation Hackathon by addressing foundational business risks.

ideas.pitch: A decentralized escrow and micro-investment simulation tool for student founders to practice bootstrapping and pitching to simulated angel investors during the networking hours.
ideas.title: VentureVouch Trust Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages autonomous escrow mechanisms proven successful at the Synthesis Hackathon to demonstrate functional monetization.

ideas.pitch: A streamlined business model canvas generator that automatically populates value propositions and revenue streams based on 3-minute mentor checkpoint feedback.
ideas.title: FounderFlow Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a problem judges and mentors feel directly in the room by accelerating the grueling overnight business plan preparation phase.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent scheduling and skill-matching app that pairs struggling teams with the exact industry expert or speaker available during the 24-hour event timeline.
ideas.title: MentorMatch Pro
ideas.why_it_could_win: Improves event efficiency for organizers and participants, matching the community-first approach of the Vanderbilt Global Good Hackathon win.
